### The Vindicated Sufferer
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/vindicated-sufferer
Passage: Isaiah 53:10-12
Points:
- Humanity broke covenant with God, leaving all people defiled and in need of redemption.
- Christ fulfills what Adam and Israel failed to do through His obedience and atoning sacrifice.
- The Servant's death was not a defeat, because His resurrection guarantees His triumph and vindication.
- By pouring out His soul unto death, Jesus secures an enduring spiritual offspring and justifies many.
- Christ's sacrifice successfully achieves actual and permanent salvation for His people.
